review_scope: Both full three-line metrics-access includes read. The fpt-only condition is retained; absence of text in other branches does not grant access. Product variables, entitlement and actual visibility require separate verification.

claims.statement: The security-overview permission fragment requires repository write access for organization views; this is distinct from individual metric visibility routes and may limit the observed dataset.
Enterprise security-overview views identify organization owners and security managers as eligible actors; enterprise ownership alone is not listed as the visibility predicate.
For fpt, the product include identifies Team-owned organizations with Secret Protection or Enterprise-owned organizations; this conditional is not a universal entitlement or authorization proof.
